context: Wrote and self-reviewed the dashboard scale redesign spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-dashboard-scale-design.md) — Approach B approved by Dave: server query layer + compact client index, canvas density timeline, drill-down graph explorer, virtualized faceted lists, health panel, scope breadcrumb, hash routing.
rationale: buys instant facets, scope rollups, and timeline bucketing at the confirmed 5k envelope; invalidated above ~20-30k records per store, API shape leaves room to move windowing server-side later.
summary: Chose client-side compact index (~200KB gzipped at 5k+5k, delta polling via since param with count-mismatch full refetch) over fully server-windowed queries
